ttsServer.title: Voice server
ttsServer.intro: The voice is made on a server: the text of each answer is sent there and the sound comes back. With no servers of your own the public OpenVoiceOS servers are used.
ttsServer.host: Your own servers, one per line
ttsServer.host.hint: Leave empty to use the public servers.
ttsServer.verify.hint: Only turn this off for a server you test with.
